track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 22: Oshagh
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Oshagh in Nava, Rast-Panjgah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C3 and dwells most on A in Oshagh. The line peaks at E4 (331.8 Hz) at 0:15.5. It closes on the tonic (A2 → G3 → A3 → A2 → A3 → A3).
